primary_dataset.name: Caravan
primary_dataset.citation: Kratzert et al., Caravan - A global community dataset for large-sample hydrology, Scientific Data 10, 61 (2023).
primary_dataset.time_zone: UTC / Local Standard Time per regional CAMELS source
limitations: Daily aggregation precludes sub-hourly peak or hydrograph lag analysis.
Catchment-averaged meteorological forcing does not represent spatial rainfall patterns within large basins.
Streamflow observations are normalized by reported gauge catchment area.
